Belgrave ladies placed highly in the Surrey Ladies Cross Country League league as individuals this winter. Wendy Cotterell was first Senior with Jacintha Coppinger third, and in the Junior ranks Jacqui Smiter was third.

In the Senior Ladies race Wendy Cotterell proved to be too strong for Jacintha Coppinger and there were other convincing wins by M. Hancock with 2:16.9 in the Boys race and an almost solo 2:02.1 by Youth F.Nico who looked very impressive.

Individually, many club records have been broken this year including: Women's 3000m Wendy Cotterell 9:48.8, Minor Girls' 70mH Melissa Simon 13.1, Girls' HJ Saskin Buckland 1.53, Junior and Youths' HJ Stanley Osuide 2.15, Men's 100m John Regis 10.20, 200m John Regis 20.11, 400mH Paul Beaumont 51.75,…
